function registerModel(string _modelId, string _name, string _description, string _ipfsCID, string _category, uint256 _pricePerUse, uint256 _subscriptionPrice, uint256 _rateLimit)

function getModel(string _modelId) view returns (tuple(string modelId, string name, string ipfsCID, address owner, uint256 pricePerUse, uint256 rateLimit, bool isActive, uint256 createdAt, uint256 totalUses))
function getModelMeta(string _modelId) view returns (tuple(string description, string category, uint256 subscriptionPrice, uint256 rating, uint256 ratingCount))
function getAllModels() view returns (tuple(string modelId, string name, string ipfsCID, address owner, uint256 pricePerUse, uint256 rateLimit, bool isActive, uint256 createdAt, uint256 totalUses)[])
event ModelRegistered(string modelId, string name, address indexed owner, string ipfsCID, uint256 pricePerUse)
event ModelUpdated(string modelId, string ipfsCID, uint256 pricePerUse)
